title: Dif final source rights and visual acceptance (RFC-BPR-0019)
reference_disclaimer: This package presents the exact production-source rights record and deterministic preview evidence for RFC-BPR-0019. The supplied opaque Dif reference images and Nib archive are not embedded or shipped; their exact identities and allowed guidance-only roles are bound in the rights subject. Visual approval is limited to the five independent subjects below. It does not approve a Qt widget, runtime composition, packaging, release, or either RFC's closeout.

subjects.display_name: Validate final rights for the exact Dif production bytes
subjects.description: Accept or reject the complete identity-bound final-rights subject. Acceptance is a representation that you are the creator/rightsholder or have authority from the creator/rightsholder to grant every stated use for these exact sources and generated products.
acceptance_criteria: The accepted pre-creation authority, exact external-input identities, recorded ImageGen and edit process, source inventory, manifest, generated products, preview renderer, and audit are correctly bound.

The checked-in Dif sources are original BetterPullReview production assets, and the stated worldwide, perpetual, commercial/noncommercial reproduction, derivative, source/binary/package, documentation, website, release, marketing, and sublicensing scope is authorized.
The guidance-only Dif images were not cropped or shipped, and the Nib archive granted no Nib, Mel, or AllTheThings art, code, name, identity, palette, dimensions, timing, or branding reuse.
No third-party license notice or SBOM entry is required for the original Dif raster assets; existing project and dependency notices remain unaffected.
Acceptance remains independent of the five visual decisions and grants no runtime, package, release, dependency, or RFC-closeout claim.
known_concerns: A mechanical audit proves file structure, inventory, digests, and searched byte markers; it cannot decide legal capacity or visual originality.
Reject with a note naming the capacity, permission, distribution, notice, input, tool, or foreign-material fact that must change.
A rights acceptance cannot substitute for any rejected or pending visual subject.

audit_verdict.note: The exact precreation verdict validated, all external input identities match their authorized digests and lengths, the complete asset tree validates, two regenerations match committed products, and the scoped foreign-material audit passed with stated attended limitations.

detail_sections.heading: Decision boundary
items: Accept only if every representation and grant in the copied final-rights subject is accurate for the exact bound bytes.
Reject if any capacity, permission, distribution, notice, tool, identity, or foreign-material assertion is inaccurate or incomplete.
This decision grants no visual, runtime, packaging, release, or RFC-closeout claim by itself.

subjects.display_name: Approve Dif's identity and foreign-identity exclusion
subjects.description: Judge the exact master-derived source frames and runtime cells as one coherent original BetterPullReview panda identity. This is the human visual gate for coherence with the authorized purple-and-light Dif direction and exclusion of Nib, Mel, and AllTheThings identity.
acceptance_criteria: Dif reads as one compact, calm, supportive purple-and-light panda across the neutral master, calm idle, greeting, and rest frames.
The friendly attentive face, silhouette, and abstract plus/minus diff-card prop remain legible at 64, 72, 96, and 256 pixels.
The prop carries no literal patch, line number, score, approval, error, review conclusion, GitHub mark, or other semantic application result.
No Nib television body, antennae, magnifying glass, geometry, palette, or motion; no Mel lotus silhouette; and no AllTheThings flattened group identity is reproduced.
The result is suitable as Dif's canonical BPR asset identity without relying on an opaque background plate, text, glow, or cast shadow.
known_concerns: The exact opaque reference images are deliberately not copied into the repository evidence package; their digest-bound identity direction is described in the rights subject.
The soft 3D-style rendering must still read cleanly at the smallest displayed scale.
This subject does not approve timing, registration, appearance contexts, or reduced-motion behavior; those have separate decisions.

audit_verdict.note: All source/runtime cells are declared canonical RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, no metadata or embedded text payload, exact hashes, and no prohibited identity string; visual identity and originality remain this attended decision.

subjects.display_name: Approve full clip motion at 64, 72, and 96 pixels
subjects.description: Judge the calm idle at its declared 250 ms per frame and the one-shot greeting at 125 ms per frame. The greeting is only a decorative acknowledgement that a landing surface became visible; it is not a product result.
acceptance_criteria: The three-frame calm idle reads as a gentle closed breath at 4 fps without walking, floating, jitter, or a duplicated terminal dwell.
The five-frame greet reads as one restrained nonsemantic acknowledgement at 8 fps and does not resemble approval, celebration, warning, reviewing, thinking, or issue discovery.
Both clips remain intentional and readable at the actual 64, 72, and 96 logical-pixel shipping sizes.
The motion uses the fewest frames needed and does not introduce clipping, edge contact, distracting prop travel, or unstable facial detail.
known_concerns: Motion is intentionally subtle: both clips use baseline-anchored scale and squash rather than limb waving or semantic expression changes.
The preview PNGs are APNG animations; the calm clip loops continuously and greet plays once per browser load or reload.
This subject does not approve registration metrics, seam/handoff quality, backgrounds, or reduced-motion fallback.

audit_verdict.note: The manifest mechanically validates the 3/5 frame counts, exact 4/8 fps rates, declared clip kinds and returns, edge clearance, frame budgets, and generated APNG timing. Aesthetic motion quality remains attended.

subjects.display_name: Approve registration, calm seam, and greet handoff
subjects.description: Judge the visual steadiness of the common body box, center, and baseline together with the exact calm-loop seam and greet-to-idle return. Mechanical tolerances already pass; this question is whether they look stable.
acceptance_criteria: Every calm, greet, and rest frame stays visually anchored to the cyan center line and red ground baseline inside the shared yellow neutral body box.
The calm last-to-first seam is not perceptibly discontinuous or dwell-heavy at 64, 72, or 96 pixels.
The greet completes and returns to the calm representative without a pop, jump, extra hold, or visible registration shift at all three sizes.
The diff card does not silently recenter the body, and feet, ears, hands, and prop remain comfortably inside the cell.
known_concerns: Overlay lines are diagnostic and not shipped; they intentionally cover one pixel of the preview.
The calm seam course alternates only the final and first calm frames to expose their boundary.
The greet handoff course loops the full greet plus the calm representative so the return can be watched repeatedly.

audit_verdict.note: All clips share body bounds [56,22,200,224], visual center x=128, baseline y=223, <=1px allowed vertical travel, calm seam mean delta 1 <= 2, and greet handoff mean delta 0 <= 1.

subjects.display_name: Approve all four appearance contexts at three scales
subjects.description: Judge each clip representative across the deterministic System, Light, Dark, and high-contrast context plates at 1.0x, 1.25x, and 2.0x relative to the 96-pixel landing size. These plates test contrast and silhouette; they do not claim native OS rendering.
acceptance_criteria: The face, outline, purple/light palette, feet, hands, and diff card remain distinguishable on System, Light, Dark, and black high-contrast surfaces.
No context requires a baked background plate, glow, cast shadow, forced palette, stylesheet, or text to separate Dif from the surface.
The calm, greet, and rest representatives remain coherent at 96, 120, and 192 pixels, corresponding to the declared 1.0x, 1.25x, and 2.0x context course.
No clipping, halo, chroma-key fringe, hidden opaque rectangle, or background-dependent semantic change appears in any plate.
known_concerns: System is a fixed neutral preview color, not a target-native palette capture; RFC-BPR-0020 will own native runtime appearance integration.
The 36 plates are ordered by clip representative, then scale, with System/Light/Dark/high-contrast across each row.
This subject does not approve runtime composition or platform-native high-contrast behavior.

audit_verdict.note: The preview renderer deterministically composites every representative over four opaque contexts at 96/120/192 pixels from the exact source and manifest bytes; source and generated PNGs retain transparent backgrounds.

subjects.display_name: Approve the awake static rest fallback
subjects.description: Judge the exact static rest pose as the reduced-motion and suspended fallback beside the representative frame of each animated clip. It must preserve Dif's identity without procedural motion, sleep, fade, or semantic status.
acceptance_criteria: The rest frame is calm, awake, friendly, and visibly the same Dif identity as both animated representatives.
The static pose remains readable at 64, 72, and 96 pixels without animation, fade, pulse, glow, or background plate.
Rest does not read as asleep, disabled, offline, completed, approved, errored, or otherwise semantically different from decorative presence.
The comparison does not reveal an objectionable scale, center, baseline, face, prop, or silhouette jump between rest and the animated representatives.
known_concerns: The rest source is byte-identical to the neutral master and calm representative by design; visual sameness is the accessibility feature, not an omitted animation.
The comparison sheet is 256 pixels per pose, while the separate static previews show actual 64/72/96 shipping sizes.
Runtime reduced-motion observation and lifecycle behavior belong to RFC-BPR-0020 and are not approved here.

audit_verdict.note: The rest clip contains exactly one declared static frame at duration 0, returns to rest, shares the common registration contract, and is emitted without APNG control chunks or procedural motion.
